# R03 — 320-unit inward reservations

The user selected 320 for the complete ordinary support/base space allowance and explicitly requested no profile investigation. The previously accepted rule keeps all masonry, shafts and bases outside the reserved vault spaces. These are accepted study instructions, not approval of a finished pier or a new cathedral layout.

This bounded experiment moves inward through three ordinary straight nave aisle rows, then mirrors the transverse allocation. It preserves the main vessel's 5866 reference width and the 1152 / 1344 / 1536 clear aisle widths. Each intervening support row receives one 320-unit reservation, counted once. The reservation adjoining the main vessel is a plan-space placeholder; it does not establish the adequacy of its high-vault support.

The clear width decisions follow the user's instruction; source grids did not independently certify finished floor clearances. Original saved geometry remains unchanged. In this separate experiment, aisle locations move outward to accommodate reservations while their widths remain fixed.

The retained 250 outer respond allowance and 320 external wall are working assumptions from R02. The user selected the 320 support allowance; that does not independently validate the respond depth, outer wall or high-vessel/crossing supports. No actual profile, rib, arch, base or capacity was investigated.

## North-side dimension chain

| Zone | Y start | Y end | Width |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Main-vessel half | 0 | 2933 | 2933 |
| Support reservation 1 | 2933 | 3253 | 320 |
| A1 clear | 3253 | 4405 | 1152 |
| Support reservation 2 | 4405 | 4725 | 320 |
| A2 clear | 4725 | 6069 | 1344 |
| Support reservation 3 | 6069 | 6389 | 320 |
| A3 clear | 6389 | 7925 | 1536 |
| Outer respond allowance | 7925 | 8175 | 250 |
| Outer wall allowance | 8175 | 8495 | 320 |

South is the mirror. Conditional outside width: **16990**, compared with **14570** in R01's external-wall-only study. The difference is **2420**, comprising six internal 320 strips and two 250 respond allowances. This is a transverse sample, not the complete cathedral's maximum extent.

## Next coordination check

The longitudinal lower cadence has two clear cells of 1800. A 320 intermediate support reservation makes their combined clear-face-to-clear-face envelope **3920**. The original main-vessel reference bay is **3600**. R02's repeating lower module between end-support centres is **4240** after also allocating half an end support at each end. These are different measurements.

They cannot be treated as one uniform updated grid without checking where main and subsidiary springing/support lines fall. This package therefore does not repeat the 4240 module through the high vessel, stretch any 3600 vault, resize the lower cells, or propagate a new nave station chain. Next prepare a plan-only comparison of major and subsidiary support stations, preserving both vault sizes; pier profiles remain outside scope. Any experimental offset must be labelled, rather than silently moving protected models.

## Evidence and validation

Reuses the already recovered F5ZE dimensions bundled in R02; its SHA-256 is recorded in parameters.json. R02 parent checkpoint: GitHub commit `9846d82831805cb0fcb83c20a88b7f94ffcd5896`. Governance was recovered during this ongoing inward-development task; no repeated archive reads were needed.

Dimension-chain checks passed: six aisle widths, main-vessel width, six 320 support strips, no overlapping strip interiors, symmetry and total outside width. Saved JSON round-tripped; native SVG parsed. The PNG is visually inspected separately. These are technical and local 2D geometric checks, not architectural, historical or structural approval.

The graphic is a transverse dimension chain, not an elevation. The native SVG is an XY plan-allocation strip with an arbitrary 1200-long X slice; its bands do not assert full solid masonry walls between aisles. One SVG user unit equals one project unit; no physical metre conversion is established.

No F5ZK-C/F5ZN-A or saved chevet geometry, approved generator, V13 original or Pass 6J record is changed. F5ZL-C's missing support schedule remains unresolved. Crossing, curved chevet, exceptional chapels and longitudinal propagation are excluded.

Reproduce with `python build_strip.py` (matplotlib). After the first build, parameters.json makes the script self-contained.
